description: The effective configuration for this dir (ansible-config dump) with each setting's origin (ansible.cfg, env, default); galaxy server tokens and passwords are always redacted. Settings this server overrides for safety in its other tools (vault password files, inventory and vars plugins) are flagged.

all.description: Every setting, not only those changed from the defaults

dir.description: Ansible project directory. Default: ANSIBLE_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring of the setting name

name: ansible_config
title: Effective Ansible config
